title: SalesPatriot (YC W25) Is Hiring FDEs
summary: SalesPatriot, a startup from Y Combinator's Winter 2025 batch, is actively recruiting Forward Deployed Engineers to work directly with customers on implementation, integration, and real-time feedback collection.
problem_solved: Finding technical talent who can bridge engineering and customer success at an early-stage YC startup.
why_valuable: Y Combinator companies offer significant equity upside and the opportunity to work closely with customers in a high-growth environment.
